description.value: The Sparwood Museum, operated by the Michel-Natal-Sparwood Heritage Society, preserves over 115 years of coal mining and community history through artifacts and images spanning the communities of Corbin, Michel, Middletown, Natal, and Sparwood. Beyond the galleries, cyclists can follow a free self-guided mural and artifacts tour through downtown Sparwood, visit the iconic Titan Truck — one of the world's largest mining dump trucks — or book a mine tour at the nearby Sparwood Visitor Centre. It is a rich cultural anchor for anyone riding through the Elk Valley.
